guatemala.title: Flag of the Republic of Guatemala

colors.note: Vertical bands at hoist and fly; represents the Pacific and Atlantic oceans and the sky.
Central vertical band bearing the coat of arms; represents peace and purity.
Sun rays and scroll on the coat of arms; symbolises prosperity.
Laurel wreath and quetzal tail on the coat of arms; stands for liberty.

desc:
- Three vertical bands of sky blue, white, and sky blue with the national coat of arms centred on the white band
- The coat of arms features a resplendent quetzal, a scroll of 15 September 1821 (independence), rifles, swords, and a laurel wreath
- Adopted on 17 August 1871 by decree after the Liberal Revolution led by Justo Rufino Barrios
trivia:
- The resplendent quetzal on the coat of arms is the national bird, a symbol of liberty because it cannot live in captivity
- The sky blue is brighter than Honduras's or El Salvador's, distinguishing Guatemala from its federation-era neighbours
- The scroll records the date of Central America's independence from Spain: 15 de Septiembre de 1821
